topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't shake the image of the sleek, expensive car parked discreetly in their garage, only now revealed because of the storm that knocked down part of the fence. All this time, I've been slaving away, counting pennies, while my neighbor lived like a king right next door, hidden behind a façade of modesty. I have to do something, I can’t just let this go. Maybe I can use this, find a way to change my fortunes. I need to think, need to figure out the next move. The disparity gnaws at me, a constant, silent scream in my head.
